dct_description_sm: Mali administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 03. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 20 Région - Admin 2: 160 Cercle Note: The normal administrative level 2 feature type(s) are region (20 features) and cercle (160units). Dates associated with this dataset: - 10 June 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 04 September 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 13 May 2025: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 20 February 2025: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
